title: Useful Keybinds
description:
This pack should install with minimal keybind conflicts out the box. Feel free to customize the controls to your liking, but here's some useful defaults:

` (Open This Questbook)
P (Open Coin Pouch)
B (Open Backpack)
Z (Zoom View)
M (Open World Map)
N (New Waypoint)
- and = (Zoom Minimap)
K (Toggle Shaders)
R (Reload Shaders)
T [in inventory] (Toggle Trash Slot)
